rules.accepted_credit_types: Category I (accredited sponsorship) and Category II (nonaccredited sponsorship and other meritorious learning); AAPA standards are used to judge acceptance and category
rules.alternatives: In lieu of 100 hours: current NCCPA certification; or compliance with an AAPA or NCCPA continuing maintenance of competency program; or other commission-approved programs.
rules.new_licensee_rule: The two-year CME review period begins on the first birthday after receiving the initial license.
rules.audit_note: Affidavit of compliance at renewal; random audits under WAC 246-12-190; keep CME documentation at least four years after the renewal period (commission FAQ).

topics.who: All PAs except those with only brief, limited or no patient contact; DOH model-list training, by end of first full CE reporting period after initial licensure
All PAs: every four years (WAC 246-12-800 to 246-12-830)
PAs licensed to prescribe opioids; best practices/opioid prescribing rules, by end of first full CE reporting period after initial licensure

rules.notes: License renews every two years on the birthday. Fee: $247 two-year renewal plus $32 HEAL-WA and $140 physician health program surcharges (WAC 246-918-990).
